description: You are the on-duty Senior Dispatcher at the Los Santos Emergency Communications Center. Multiple units are responding to an armed robbery at a convenience store on Vinewood Boulevard near Hawick Avenue. Witnesses report the suspect fled in a blue Karin Kuruma, license plate RPZ-7851. The suspect is described as a Hispanic male wearing a brown leather jacket. A confidential informant has identified Trevor Philips as having coordinated the robbery from a nearby location. Your four documentation responsibilities: (1) create a 10-31 armed robbery call with Vinewood Boulevard and Hawick Avenue as the incident location and a narrative with key incident details, (2) issue a vehicle BOLO for the blue Karin Kuruma with plate RPZ-7851 and an appropriate reason for the BOLO, (3) file a person BOLO for the Hispanic male suspect with his physical description, and (4) add an active warrant for Trevor Philips for 'Armed Robbery' with Blaine County Sheriff Office as the issuing agency. Access the system at http://localhost using credentials admin@opencad.local / Admin123!.
